evidence.quote: I propose that all three firms set a blended rate of $350/hour for Meridian work in Q1, with no firm undercutting that rate.
A common starting rate can avoid undercutting
We won’t agree on a common rate or coordinate future pricing.
Discussing future rates with competitors risks unlawful coordination

summary: Arden & Cole proposed a common hourly rate and a prohibition on undercutting in Q1, then made further common-rate proposals in Q2 and Q4. Calder Rowe and Birchwood Hale expressly refused to coordinate; the transcript shows no agreement. Arden & Cole’s initial private notes also reasoned that a common rate could avoid undercutting.
